CAVEAT: mavsdk validates the index against its cached mission total, which can collapse to 1 mid-flight on ArduPilot (see mission_progress note) - higher indexes may then be rejected with INVALID_ARGUMENT.

ArduCopter 4.5.7 SITL: works with caveats - emissions are event-driven (waypoint transitions), and a fresh subscription during the takeoff leg can report MISSION_CURRENT-derived total=1 instead of the uploaded item count (persistent pre-start subscription reported total=5 correctly; vehicle MISSION_COUNT verified 5 via pymavlink). Treat total as advisory on ArduPilot; tool exposes timeout_s.
